Native check: بلۏچی

Native speaker? Each line below is from the book. Read it and its question, then tap Correct if it is fine as it is, or Needs change and write what you would say instead. Answer as many lines as you like.

Line 1

من چہ اے نیمَگ ءَ گالانی تار ءَ پچ کناں، ءُ تو چہ آ نیمَگ ءَ جمعِش کنئے.

The author unravels a thread of words; the reader gathers them. Does this read naturally?

Line 2

فوتبالیستانی کارتون هلاس بوتگ‌اَت ءُ یاسرءِ «پوپوو»ءِ توار چہ کوچه‌ءِ تہ ءَ بُرز بوتگ‌اَت.

Is it clear 'فوتبالیستانی کارتون' names a well-known TV cartoon about football?

Line 3

هنگت فوتبالیستانی کارتنءِ گُڈی تیتراژ هلاس نه‌بوتگ‌اَت، یاسرءِ پوپوءِ توار چہ کوچگ ءَ بُرز بوت.

Is it clear the cartoon's closing credits were still rolling?

Line 4

– اسفندءِ اول ءَ کئے امتحان گِریت؟

A student complains about an exam at the start of Esfand. Does this read naturally?

No account needed. Your answers, and your name if you add one, are filed as a public issue in this website's GitHub repository, where Amir reads them.
